title: Search-Based Testing of Modality Sensitivity in Vision Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.32360v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) process images and text jointly, yet robustness evaluations often perturb these inputs separately or assess only predefined corruption levels. Such evaluations provide limited evidence of which modality is more susceptible to perturbations and whether smaller changes across both modalities can jointly expose failures. We present MoST, a black-box testing framework that characterizes modality sensitivity by comparing image-only, text-only, and joint perturbations. MoST uses multi-objective search to select and combine perturbations and adjust their severity, seeking prediction degradation while limiting changes to images and prompts. We evaluate MoST on four VLMs performing object localization on ImageNet and driving images. The models exhibit distinct sensitivities: textual perturbations dominate for some, whereas others are susceptible across both modalities. In several configurations, joint perturbations

translated_title: 基于搜索的视觉语言模型模态敏感性测试
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）联合处理图像和文本，然而现有的鲁棒性评估通常分别扰动这两类输入，或仅评估预定义的损坏等级。这样的评估对于“哪种模态更容易受到扰动影响”以及“两种模态中较小的变化能否共同暴露模型缺陷”所提供的证据十分有限。我们提出了MoST，这是一个黑盒测试框架，通过对比仅图像扰动、仅文本扰动和联合扰动来刻画模态敏感性。MoST采用多目标搜索来选择和组合扰动并调整其严重程度，在尽量限制对图像和提示词改动的同时，寻求引发模型预测性能的退化。我们在四个VLM上评估了MoST，这些模型在ImageNet和驾驶图像上执行目标定位任务。实验结果表明各模型表现出不同的敏感性：某些模型对文本扰动更为脆弱，而另一些模型则在两种模态下均易受影响。在若干配置下，联合扰动…
tldr: 本文提出黑盒测试框架MoST，通过多目标搜索系统对比图像、文本及联合扰动，首次揭示视觉语言模型对不同模态扰动的敏感性存在显著差异。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MoST, a black-box testing framework using multi-objective search to compare image-only, text-only, and joint perturbations, revealing distinct modality sensitivity in vision-language models.
